info.cls_ename: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

description.describe_ch: 課程中將介紹電晶體、積體電路與半導體製程技術的發展沿革、半導體產業發展現況、半導體材料的物理性質、晶圓廠運作程序、晶圓生產製造技術與原理以及積體電路的應用期許學生能對目前半導體產業的材料選用、晶圓製造及積體電路製程技術有完整瞭解。另外亦將介紹先進製程技術在次世代半導體元件應用所面臨的挑戰與未來發展趨勢。
description.describe_eh: The course will introduce the development history of transistors, integrated circuits (IC), and processing technologies, the current status of the development of the semiconductor industry, the physical properties of semiconductor materials, the operation procedures of wafer fabs, wafer manufacturing technologies and principles, and the application of integrated circuits. Students are expected to have a complete understanding of material selection, wafer fabrication, and advanced integrated circuit processing technology in the current semiconductor industry. In addition, the challenges and future development directions of related processing technologies in the application of next-generation semiconductor devices will also be introduced.

1. 本學期至少隨堂點名四次, 並對缺曠課率異常及期中考學習成效待加強同學, 進行期中預警.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 瞭解電晶體和積體電路的發展歷史與半導體工業的發展現況
courseBankC.describe_en: Understand the history of transistors and integrated circuits and the status of the semiconductor industry
courseBankC.core_item: 材料選用、設計與製程的能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Material selection, design, and process capabilities.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 熟悉半導體元件製程技術
courseBankC.describe_en: Familiar with semiconductor device fabrication process.
courseBankC.core_item: 運用數學、材料科學及工程知識的能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Possess fundamental mathematical and materials science and engineering skills.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 理解半導體製程技術原理及其應用領域
courseBankC.describe_en: Understand the principles of various semiconductor fabrication processes and their application fields
courseBankC.core_item: 發掘、分析、應用研究成果及兼顧永續發展，以解決複雜且整合性材料工程問題的能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: The ability to discover, analyze, apply research results, and consider sustainable development to solve complex and integrated materials engineering problems.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 瞭解半導體製程技術發展趨勢和未來前景
courseBankC.describe_en: To know the development trends and future prospects of semiconductor manufacturing technology
courseBankC.core_item: 認識時事議題，瞭解材料工程技術對環境永續、社會共好及全球發展的影響，並培養持續學習的習慣與能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Understand current issues, understand the impact of material engineering technology on environmental sustainability, social good, and global development, and cultivate the habit and ability of continuous learning.
